summary: Nexentis Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to an existing credit facility agreement with L.I.A. Pure Capital Ltd. The amendment increases the facility from EUR 6,000,000 to EUR 10,000,000 and adjusts the anti-dilution mechanism on a warrant to purchase 1,850,000 shares at $1.00 per share. No new equity issuance, tender offer, or restructuring is involved; it is a routine financing arrangement. No change of control, board recommendation, or special situation is present. This is a standard debt facility amendment with no event-driven catalyst or risk-arb opportunity.
